        auxArr[0] = 1
        myexactlog(4, auxArr)
    for i in range(0, n):
        myexactlog(5, 0)
        if s[i] == "1":
            myexactlog(6, 1)
            auxArr[i] = auxArr[i - 1] + 1
            myexactlog(7, auxArr)
        else:
            myexactlog(8, 0)
            pass
        break
